metadata.reviewer: AI visual inspection of unmarked native-cadence ball/club crops
metadata.status: provisional visual ball-departure intervals; independent second review pending
metadata.semantics: Lower frame shows ball still at its original position; upper frame shows flight or clear departure. Interval includes exposure and occlusion uncertainty. Not a precisely measured club-ball contact time or ground-contact label.
metadata.selection: First shot of each session plus the six reviewed-ball 100-yard gate errors; diagnostic selection, not a representative accuracy test.
